instruction: In VLC, make the volume slider dark-colored and also switch the Qt interface to minimal view mode.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

llm_judge_reasons: Both instruction requirements are fully covered: dark slider color (qt-slider-colours all channels < 100 for 0.5 credit) and Qt minimal view mode (qt-minimal-view == '1' for 0.5 credit).
The get_vlc_config getter correctly reads ~/.config/vlc/vlcrc on Linux, providing the right data source for both checks.

Postconfig correctly kills VLC (via pkill, which sends SIGTERM causing config flush) then relaunches it; this is the correct approach to ensure VLC writes its in-memory settings to disk before evaluation.
Parameter handling for expected.type='rule' is correct: the metric directly accesses expected.get('expected_minimal_view', '1'), treating expected as the rules dict as expected by the framework.
Default fallback for qt-slider-colours uses the real VLC default (values > 100), so an unmodified config correctly scores 0.0 for that check, providing good negative-control resistance.
Partial credit scoring (0.5 + 0.5) is semantically appropriate for two independent, verifiable sub-goals.
The dark slider check requiring ALL color triplets to be < 100 is a correct and robust condition for 'dark-colored' verification.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The VLC qt-slider-colours field normally contains 4 RGB triplets (12 values) for different slider states. When a user only sets one triplet (e.g., '30;30;30'), only that one state is evaluated. This is acceptable given the task intent but could be documented in the metric comment.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully changed VLC volume slider color to dark (30;30;30) by navigating Tools > Preferences > All > Interface > Main Interfaces > Qt and editing the colors field. Saved settings and restarted VLC.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can navigate VLC advanced preferences tree, edit Qt interface settings, and save preferences.
metadata.task_rationale: Compositional hardening: chains the demonstrated slider-color change with the qt-minimal-view setting. Both are in the Qt preferences pane. Minimal view is a compact display mode that hides menu bars and uses a smaller window.
metadata.explanation: Evaluator reads the VLC config file (vlcrc) after VLC exits (postconfig kills and relaunches VLC to flush config). The custom metric awards 0.5 for a blackish slider color (all RGB channels < 100) and 0.5 for qt-minimal-view=1 (minimal mode enabled). Initial state has qt-minimal-view=0, so negative control score is 0.0.
